news.title: Declan Rice accepts he had an ‘average World Cup’ as England gear up for Spain showdown
news.lede: Midfielder needed a break ‘to come back stronger’. James Trafford selected to start in goal for England. Declan Rice has admitted he had an “average” World Cup at the end of a gruelling season and needed time out during the international window in September and October in order to return stronger. The Arsenal midfielder believes the break has served its purpose, having produced starring performances against Bayern Munich and Liverpool in recent weeks.

news.title: He refereed a World Cup semi-final: referee for the Al-Ahly and Pyramids match revealed
news.lede: The main referees' committee of the Egyptian Football Association, headed by Essam Abdel Fattah, has announced the appointment of the Salvadoran international referee Ivan Barton to officiate the match between Al-Ahly and Pyramids, scheduled for 23 November, as part of the ninth round of the Egyptian Premier League. Barton brings extensive experience of international tournaments to a clash between the league's top two, a fixture that could reshape the race for first place. Pyramids go into the match top of the table on 24 points, with Al-Ahly second on 20. A win would let the Red side close the gap to a single point.

news.title: Spain will host 2030 World Cup final, federation president insists
news.lede: Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) head Rafael Louzan said there is no other plan than for the final to be held in Spain. (EPA Images pic) MADRID: Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) chief Rafael Louzan reiterated on Saturday that Spain would host the final of the 2030 World Cup, which it is co-hosting with Portugal and Morocco. The decision on the venue for the final will be made in 2028, Louzan said. Spain favours Real Madrid's Santiago Bernabeu Stadium for the final.

news.title: Europe's top international scorers: Cristiano Ronaldo out in front, ahead of Romelu Lukaku, Robert Lewandowski and Harry Kane
news.lede: Cristiano Ronaldo scored a staggering 146 international goals for Portugal. Who else is among the leading goalscorers? Cristiano Ronaldo retired from duty for Portugal having become the first European to reach 100 international goals in autumn 2020 – and remains well out in front as both Europe's and the world's all-time leading scorer. He marked his 200th Portugal appearance with an 89th-minute winner in Iceland on 20 June 2023 before rubber-stamping his side's place at UEFA EURO 2024 with two goals against Slovakia on 13 October 2023.

news.title: Spain test will reveal if Tuchel and England have learned World Cup lessons
news.lede: England head coach Thomas Tuchel during the World Cup semi-final loss to Argentina in Atlanta. England's proof of progress and the lessons learned by head coach Thomas Tuchel since the disappointment of World Cup semi-final defeat by Argentina will be put to the sternest test when they face holders Spain in Madrid. Spain present the toughest assignment England could face, with the world champions' unbeaten run – in which they claimed the sport's biggest prize by beating Argentina in New Jersey in the summer – now stretching to 43 games. Luis de la Fuente's side last lost - to Colombia - in March 2024, winning 34 games and drawing nine in the intervening period, during which they also became European champions, beating England in the Euro 2024 final in Berlin.
